alate: Alate: head pale yellowish brown, a pair of indistinct pale markings on the inner side in front of the ocelli, with another pair of distinct pale markings inside them; pronotum dull yellow, abdomen yellow, wing scales pale brown, wings pale yellow. The body covered with sparse long hairs and rather dense short hairs, the wing scales with a few long hairs, the wings covered with rather dense irregularly arranged short hairs. Head nearly circular, its dorsum flat and slightly inclined backwards; labrum broadly tongue-shaped; postclypeus nearly half as long as wide, the middle of its posterior margin slightly concave, with a median longitudinal suture; compound eyes nearly round, ocelli oval, fontanelle circular; antennae with 19 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shorter than the fourth. On the left mandible the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth is longer than half the posterior margin of the apical tooth, its posterior margin slightly longer than half the anterior margin of the second marginal tooth, and the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth slightly shorter than the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth; on the right mandible the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth bears a distinct subapical tooth, the posterior margin of the second marginal tooth wavy. The pronotum slightly longer than half its width, the sides arcuate, widest near the middle or slightly in front, the median notch of the anterior margin shallow and broad, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly concave, the middle of the posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum deeply concave with the sides projecting posteriorly as obtuse angles. Wings distinctly rather narrow; in the forewing the media arising independently at the humeral suture and closer to the cubitus, with one branch at the middle and one at the end, the cubitus with 8–9 branches; the hindwing broader than the forewing, its media arising from the radial sector beyond the wing scale. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2.
soldier: Soldier: the base of the mandibles projects as a wavy edge, the labrum broadly spear-shaped, widest towards the posterior part, contracted at the tip, the transparent area triangular. The inner margin of the fontanelle aperture triangular, its basal width and height nearly equal, the rim almost vertical in profile. Antennae with 14 segments, the second larger than the fourth, the third shortest. Postmentum rather narrow and long, its widest part arched spherically, the oblique margins slightly concave near the middle; the narrowest waist situated near the posterior end; seen from the side, the anterior dorsal margin is rather straight, while the ventral margin bulges slightly at the widest part of the postmentum. The pronotum rather flat and extended, its length slightly more than half its width; the lateral margins broader in the anterior part, the middle of the anterior margin projecting slightly forwards and concave downwards, the notch both shallow and broad; the posterior margin narrower than the anterior, broadly straight, only slightly concave at the very middle. The hind tibia rather short, the arrangement of the spurs on each leg being three, two, two.
